checks.source_only_no_science: All three tools parse as AST; imports are ordinary metadata/stdlib only. No candidate/HF import, NPZ decode, observer, scientific computation, rendering, installation or numeric retry is implemented. No tool was executed during this review.
checks.prepare_source_identity: Preparer requires clean main=BASE and origin/main=BASE, absent new stage, actual PASS peer records with false authorization/execution and nonempty peer SHA maps matching all actual external source/card/doc bytes. Source author pins and candidate AST are checked before writes.
checks.58_old_bindings: The exact input audit union is six pure sources, 29 raw NPZ, 21 ordinary records and two prior cost records: 58 unique old bindings. Static metadata comparison confirms every SHA in the existing manifest. The preparer itself will raw-hash only these selected old files, not decode them or scan the old archive.
checks.new_stage_and_protocol: Preparer archives current and initial source author receipts, input/physics/wrapper/math reports, worker and original launcher bytes, then writes protocol with actual old/new binding SHA. It does not bind the future protocol to itself. Prepared/authorized/executed history is preserved as true/false/false.
checks.protocol_wrapper_correspondence: Protocol has the reviewed wrapper required keys, exact original 14 targets, view180/outer240/8GiB, 29-NPZ/279-field declarations, old raw gates, 14+14 observations, 9842 node rows, 14 metrics/196 differences, six PNG/one 14-frame GIF and snapshot indices6/13. Failed/time_limit and incomplete/unload-false qualifications remain.
checks.launcher_reuse: The exact original generic launcher is copied to the new depth-three stage. Its parents[3] still resolves to the clone root and its phase argv uses the new stage. It remains one invocation, cooperative stop/tree-RSS and no force; it does not itself manufacture authorization.
checks.portable_math_links: The math MD alone rewrites current root links to ../../../../ relative to stage/author and .py:line to #Lline, with original SHA and explicit archival note. Existing ordinary JSON remains byte-preserved; source conclusions/numbers are not regenerated.
checks.two_front_history: Each front is checked against git show BASE:path, prefixed once with the actual body/relative stage links and archived in one contiguous exact byte interval. current.count(old)==1 and recorded old/new SHA/byte indices ensure the complete current history survives; no third old front is changed.
checks.configure_actual_records: Configure requires the actual prepared protocol/receipt SHA and bindings, absent run/auth, current source-only tool review with all actual external SHA matching, then archives tools/reviews once. It checks all stage local MD links remain inside the clone and point to existing files, and confirms the recorded front byte intervals/old-new SHA. The config enumerates every actual stage file plus exactly the preparation fronts, config itself and the sole future final review; no final review self-hash is required.
checks.fixed_old_publication_and_manifest: Delivery binds the true old M-ALPHA1 execution publication receipt, published BASE and original execution not_pass/closed. Raw old manifest SHA,18761 entries/9646933366 bytes, science0.5.0/baseline match. Old entries are inherited; neither finalize nor verify raw-hashes the old9.65GB.
checks.precise_finalize_delta: Finalize requires staged-only exact allowed delta: two existing fronts plus every new-stage file, no deleted old path, no outside delta, no untracked/unstaged file and manifest initially equal BASE. Only allowed file bytes are hashed. Preparation checks disallow run/auth/stop/launch/view receipts and require stage file-set equality.
checks.final_review_contract: The independent final actual review must bind actual config SHA and current delivery source, false authorization/execution, all allowed-delta file hashes except its self plus all protocol binding pins. Every declared external/repository SHA is checked; archived delivery bytes must equal the external reviewed source.
checks.verify_restore_contract: After separate real commit/push/restore, verify requires direct BASE parent, main/origin in both clean trees, remote main equal, identical manifest/config, exact tracked path-set/diff, actual full new delta identity in both trees and old entry/version/baseline inheritance. No git mutation is part of this helper.
checks.future_source_proof: Only successful real verify writes publication_receipt.json with prepared_card M-AVIEW1, published_commit actual child HEAD, published_and_incrementally_restored_pass, prepared true and authorized/executed false. These fields match the reviewed wrapper future source-proof contract.
checks.receipt_and_config_limits: Final config and actual packet do not exist yet in this source review; unique exclusive external delta/publication receipts are future results. Actual preparation/config/final static review are required before finalize. Source PASS is not publication, authorization or display execution PASS.
